Package foms.tools

Class OrderCleanupScheduler

java.lang.Object
foms.tools.OrderCleanupScheduler
public class OrderCleanupScheduler extends Object
The OrderCleanupScheduler class manages scheduled tasks for cleaning up expired orders in the Food Ordering Management System (FOMS).

  • Method Details

    • startOrderCleanupTask

      public static void startOrderCleanupTask()
      Starts the scheduled task to check for and cancel expired orders. The task is scheduled to run at a fixed rate of once every minute, beginning immediately upon system startup. Each execution of the task queries the OrdersController for expired orders, cancels them, and logs the IDs of orders that were canceled due to their expiration status. This method ensures that users do not encounter orders that should no longer be active due to the passage of time.
